items.q: Incomplete distal renal tubular acidosis is found in what proportion of medullary sponge kidney patients, producing a Ca₃(PO₄)₂ stone?
items.exp: Association of MSK: incomplete distal RTA in 50% → calcium phosphate Ca₃(PO₄)₂ stone. (Book p792)

items.q: Which option correctly pairs the associations of medullary sponge kidney listed in the book?
opts: Incomplete distal RTA in 50% (giving a Ca3(PO4)2 stone), Marfan's syndrome and Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome
Complete distal RTA in 50% (giving a calcium oxalate stone), Marfan's syndrome and Alport syndrome
Incomplete proximal RTA in 5% (giving a uric acid stone), Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome and Alport syndrome
Distal RTA in 50% (giving a uric acid stone), Marfan's syndrome and nail-patella syndrome
items.exp: Associations of medullary sponge kidney: incomplete distal renal tubular acidosis in 50% (producing a Ca3(PO4)2 stone), Marfan's syndrome and Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome. (Book p792)

items.q: The RFT in medullary sponge kidney is:
items.exp: Investigation in MSK: RFT normal; NCCT shows medullary nephrocalcinosis; excretory urography shows rounded densities in the medulla — paintbrush/bouquet of flower appearance. (Book p792)

items.q: A patient with recurrent stones has an NCCT kidney showing calcification confined to the medullary pyramids. This is reported as:
items.exp: NCCT in MSK: medullary nephrocalcinosis (figure 'medullary nephrolithiasis' with CT showing medullary calcification). (Book p792)

items.q: Match each medullary sponge kidney investigation with its finding — 1) RFT  2) NCCT  3) Excretory urography … A) Rounded densities in the medulla giving a paintbrush/bouquet of flower appearance  B) Medullary nephrocalcinosis  C) Normal
items.exp: MSK investigations: RFT is normal, NCCT shows medullary nephrocalcinosis, and excretory urography shows rounded densities in the medulla described as a paintbrush or bouquet of flower appearance. (Book p792)

items.q: Fill up: Excretory urography in medullary sponge kidney shows a ______ appearance or bouquet of flower appearance.
items.exp: Excretory urography in MSK: rounded medullary densities — paintbrush/bouquet of flower appearance. (Book p792)

items.q: All but one of the following are described in medullary sponge kidney. Which is the odd one out?
items.exp: MSK shows a normal RFT with medullary nephrocalcinosis and paintbrush/bouquet appearance on urography; enlarged kidneys with multiple macrocysts describe ADPKD/ARPKD. (Book p792)
